statement: Hardcore ironman rule: one life; if you die you must create a new account.
Only one character allowed; the forced second character is left in town and used as a timer.
Can only use a solo guild so no benefits from joining a max level guild.
Account must be public so progress can be seen.
Gem shop and companions are free to play only; can roll weekly and buy anything in gem shop.
No parties allowed so no boss carries for fourth Prague or third boss.
Auto loot is allowed because game is basically unplayable without it.
Goal of the challenge is to defeat Chizoar; series continues until Chizoar is beaten regardless of deaths.
Soft cap is defeating Chizoar; dying in world four or five ends that episode. Overall goal is reaching Cattle Crook before world six.
Lava's advice: do four quests for scriptures and ignore all other quests; put talent points into Sharpened Axe.
Grab the best early hat in the game for extra defense.
Went Warrior because they eventually want Squire for defense and accuracy talents.
Second tab: one point in Power Strike and one in Double Strike for double hit chance; rest into Carry a Big Stick.
First tab: focus mostly on Sharpened Axe and Wisdom.
Put about 20 points into Beat Shank because it scales really high early and boosts damage.
Aim for about 225 accuracy by the time Amarok is defeated.
With enough accuracy you can 100 percent hit Walking Sticks.
Walking Sticks is a great early game XP spot.
Sell Walking Sticks monster mats because they are not used for anything.
Were rolling a pet looking for Crystal Custard or Rift Slug.
Crystal Custard early game doubles progression because it gives 100 drop rate and 100 XP.
Rift Slug gives 25 skill points saving many skill points for one point invested.
Put points into Carry a Big Stick for big damage.
Bust Wisdom until enough accuracy for Amarok; the sooner the better.
At Carrot map they did a party dungeon grind of 24 tickets at about 10 minutes each.
Dungeon upgrades gained: two Elf Rings for huge defense and flurbo books such as dungeonic damage and Super Source.
Farmed Rex Rings to improve skill efficiency.
When spending credits prioritize base damage first because it is the hardest scaling early game.
After base damage take total damage percent and also MP for 100 percent uptime on attacks.
Put accuracy up to 30 then Beat Shank for 2.2 percent damage and then Sharp Big Stick.
Run Enders are a hard enemy that requires lots of accuracy to kill and hit very hard.
In later worlds Run Enders can one shot the character.
Farm dog bones then gear up for the Amarok fight.
Amarok fight: dodge his fist and pulsing attacks; WASD movement makes dodging much easier than mouse clicking.
Amarok's soakable attack only does one damage.
Rage mechanic for Amarok is coming soon.
Amarok is his favorite boss for art style and being a serious boss.
Swapped to Steam to collect gems because some achievements are locked behind Steam.
After world two they did some vials.
Went back to party dungeons to defeat the second frog.
